body:
More on Catfolk from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's pages "Catfolk (9 RP)", "Catfolk" but are not part of the Catfolk entry, which is unchanged.

From d20pfsrd.com: Catfolk (9 RP)

Random Catfolk Height and Weight
Gender	Base Height	Height Modifier	Base Weight	Weight Modifier
Male	4 ft. 10 in.	+2d8 in.
(5 ft. – 6 ft. 2 in.)	120 lbs.	+(2d8×5 lbs.)
(130 – 200 lbs.)
Female	4 ft. 5 in.	+2d8 in.
(4 ft. 7 in. – 5 ft. 9 in.)	85 lbs.	+(2d8×5 lbs.)
(95 – 165 lbs.)

Gunslinger Add +1/3 to the gunslinger’s AC when using the gunslinger’s dodge deed. [JBE:BoHR:AC]
Hunter Add +1/6 to the hunter’s enhancement bonus to Dexterity when using the animal focus ability to emulate a tiger. [JBE:BoHR:AC]
Inquisitor Add +1/2 to the inquisitor’s morale bonus onIntimidate and Sense Motive checks when using the stern gaze ability. [JBE:BoHR:AC]
Investigator Add a +1 bonus to Bluff checks to impart secret messages. [JBE:BoHR:AC]
Kineticist Add +1/6 to the maximum bonus allowed by elemental overflow. [JBE:BoHR:OIitW]
Magus Add a +1/6 bonus to melee weapon attack rolls when using spell combat and fighting with unarmed strikes or natural weapons. [JBE:BoHR:AC]
Marksman Gain 1/3 of an additional daily use of the windreader ability. [JBE:BoHR:AC]
Medium Add +1/6 to the medium’s spirit bonus when channeling a Marshal or Trickster spirit. [JBE:BoHR:OIitW]
Mesmerist Add +1/6 to the DC of the mesmerist’s tricks and masterful tricks. [JBE:BoHR:OIitW]
Monk Add +5 feet to the distance by which fall damage is reduced when the monk uses the slow fall ability. This bonus cannot improve the total amount of the monk’s slow fall distance reduction by more than 1.5 times its normal granted distance (ex. 30 feet maximum reduced at 4th level, up to 135 feet maximum at 18th level). [JBE:BoHR:AC]
Ninja Add a +1 bonus to attack rolls when attacking on orcharging from higher ground. [JBE:BoHR:AC]
Occultist Add +1/4 to the DC of the occultist’s Cloud Mind focus power gained from an enchantment implement. [JBE:BoHR:OIitW]

Psion Add +1/4 to the psion’s Reflex saving throws versus area effects. [JBE:BoHR:AC]
Psychic Add +1/3 daily use of the Painful Reminder power granted by the Pain discipline. [JBE:BoHR:OIitW]
Psychic Warrior Add +1/6 to the competence bonus on attack rolls granted by the dervish path’s trance ability when you wield two weapons. [JBE:BoHR:AC]

Shifter Add +1/6 to the shifter’s enhancement bonus to Dexterity when using the tiger shifter aspect. [JBE:BoHR:OIitW]
Slayer Add a +1 bonus to sound-based Perception checks. [JBE:BoHR:AC]
Soulknife Add +1/4 to damage rolls on attacks made when using the furious charge blade skill. [JBE:BoHR:AC]
Spiritualist Add +1/4 to the amount of damage to a phantom that is prevented by the spiritualist’s etheric tether per hit point sacrificed. [JBE:BoHR:OIitW]
Summoner Add +1/4 to the number of hit points the summoner’s eidolon regains per hit point sacrificed when using the life link ability. [JBE:BoHR:AC]
Swashbuckler Add +1/4 to the number of panache points the swashbuckler regains at the start of each day; her maximum panache also increases by this amount. [JBE:BoHR:AC]
Tactician Add +1/6 to the Insight bonus to attacks against the primary foe of a coordinated strike for all collective members. [JBE:BoHR:AC]
Time Thief Add +1/4 of an additional d4 to a roll when the time thief spends a mote to boost an Acrobatics or Climb check. [JBE:BoHR:AC]
Vigilante Add +1 foot to the distance between the vigilante and the target of his Close The Gap talent. This has no effect unless the vigilante has selected this reward 5 times (or another increment of 5). [JBE:BoHR:OIitW]
Vitalist Add +1/3 to the amount of damage dealt and healed by the steal health ability. [JBE:BoHR:AC]
Warpriest Add +1/3 round to the duration of the warpriest’s Liberation ability (Liberation blessing only). [JBE:BoHR:AC]

Witch Add +1/6 to the duration of the witch’s misfortune and fortune hexes. [JBE:BoHR:AC]
Wizard Add +1/4 round to the duration of the wizard’s dazing touch (enchantment school only). [JBE:BoHR:AC]
